question: Does the prospectively frozen L8H1/L9H1/L9H4/L11H3 writer program selectively reproduce fresh is/was behavior and native-M11-reader-contracted response when every target and control patch is position-compatible?
evidence_status: Prospective confirmation. V23 native capability is open and passed; no v23 causal, reader-gradient, component, singleton, union, Shapley, or control-leak outcome has been opened. The four routes and all bars were fixed from v15/v21/v22 before this test.

searched: v15 attention factor and source-position screens
v21 complete module/head atlas and its invalid-instrument audit
v22 exact effect game and its target/P-valid, C-invalid instrument audit
all is/was capability banks through the aligned v23 gate
prior_art.known_lessons: Raw hidden-state recovery mixes weight capability with downstream use. The endpoint is behavior plus exact Q=(H_donor-H_base) contracted with the frozen native M11 margin reader. V22 established target/P replication but could not establish C selectivity because C endpoints differed. No v22 Shapley-selected subset is tested here.
prior_art.route_provenance: L9H1, L9H4, L8H1, and L11H3 were frozen before v22 from independent v15/v21 discovery. V22 then recovered 0.7221 behavior and 0.7173 Q with 0.1054/0.0751 P leakage; each singleton replicated.

frozen_design.population: All 64 v23 rows are forwarded. Target metrics use the capability-frozen jointly correct A1/A2 rows (16 and 14); P and C use all 16 rows each.
frozen_design.intervention: For each of 15 nonempty coalitions, copy donor attention c_proj input slices for the listed heads through the inclusive semantic-position prefix into the base run. No MLP or residual-stream patch belongs to the candidate program.
frozen_design.reader: One frozen gradient of the summed native base donor-answer-minus-foil margin with respect to M11 output, mapped through the literal M11 Down weight. Q is its contraction with the induced M11 bilinear hidden response difference.
frozen_design.controls: P is a same-tense temporal paraphrase; C is an answer-preserving harbor/canyon lexical substitution. All base/donor token lengths and semantic endpoints are equal by construction.

predictions.pred_a_authority_alignment_reader_hooks_: All hashes, capability ancestry, exact alignment, reader hook, all-sites self/donor closures, finiteness, and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_four_head_union_selectively_recov: The union passes recovery, cosine, direction, and both P/C leakage bars.
predictions.pred_c_at_least_three_frozen_heads_repli: At least three of four singleton arms pass behavior, Q, direction, P, and C bars.
predictions.pred_d_effect_is_distributed_and_split_s: At least three routes receive behavior and Q Shapley allocation >=0.05 and positive allocation in both frozen reporter halves.

null: Failure of B or C with valid A rejects promotion of this four-head set as a selective circuit on the registered control family. Failure of A invalidates the instrument and permits no circuit conclusion.
decision: A-D promote the four-head writer program to weight restriction plus activation-occupancy characterization. Valid A with B/C failure rejects promotion; no route or threshold is retuned on v23.
